images.nearestHeading: Leila Kuelper was born and raised in the Lake Tahoe Basin. She started her career in real estate in 2014, and quickly saw how staging could transform a listing, helping homes sell quicker and at a higher price. When she couldn't find a staging company in the area that matched what her listings needed, she started buying furniture and staging them herself. By 2018, that instinct had grown into a business of its own.
